# Jensina Group

> Jensina Group is a construction and heavy-equipment/building-material expedition company based in Karanganyar, Central Java, Indonesia, operating through two legal entities: CV Anugerah Jensina Sejahtera (construction) and PT Maju Jensina Jaya (expedition / hauling).

Jensina Group provides building construction services and transport of building materials and heavy equipment for construction projects across Central Java, Indonesia. The company is built on two entities: CV Anugerah Jensina Sejahtera, which handles construction work, and PT Maju Jensina Jaya, which handles logistics — hauling materials and heavy equipment to project sites.

## Company

- Legal entities: CV Anugerah Jensina Sejahtera, PT Maju Jensina Jaya
- Address: Ngledok, RT. 003 RW. 008, Kel. Sroyo, Kec. Jaten, Kab. Karanganyar, Jawa Tengah, Indonesia
- Phone: 081111130357
- Email: info@jensina.id
- Website: https://jensina.id
